summary: Your will meets its match in other people. You may encounter power struggles, immovable forces, or people who won't back down any more than you will. Two unstoppable things, head to head.
body: Your will meets its match in other people. You may encounter power struggles, immovable forces, or people who won't back down any more than you will. Two unstoppable things, head to head. Power dynamics may feel especially charged. You may notice quickly who has control, who wants it, and what it seems to cost. The standoff plays out in your rivalries and your relationships: you push, they push, neither blinks. Some of these battles are worth it. Most aren't. You don't have to win every collision to be powerful, and the work is knowing which fight actually changes something and leaving the rest.
gift: At your best: courageous, regenerative, unbreakable under pressure.
shadow: The trap: locked-in power struggles you can't win and won't quit.
integration: Use intensity with consent and purpose. Power becomes cleaner when it is not trying to prove that no one can control you.
do: Pick the fight that transforms something
Walk away from the standoff that doesn't
Use the force, don't become it
dont: Get locked in a battle of wills
Push just to prove you can
